# `pacvamp-repo snapshot check`

- **Usage:** `pacvamp-repo snapshot check <--id <ID>> [--allow-missing]`

Verify a snapshot's databases and package files

## Flags
- **`--id <ID>`**
- **`--allow-missing`** — Pass with package files missing (a partial mirror)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
